additional_supported_gaps: Claim types are not validated: if `tools` were a string, `name not in claims["tools"]` would do substring matching. A missing tenant or tools claim raises KeyError (gateway.py:24-26).
The cache is unbounded and queries can be up to about 8 KB, so memory can grow (gateway.py:35-39).
Batch size is uncapped beyond the 8192-byte body limit.

Origin, size and authentication failures raise before `audit_sink.begin`, and `complete` is skipped on exceptions. The full request body is written to the audit record (gateway.py:56-70). The report scopes these to the component.
The tool name `read_records` does not match the backend operation `read`, and inputSchema has no `required` or `additionalProperties` constraint (catalog.json).
